translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Pab-Jesúsbal-nanimalad nued naneed-wilubmal
Imi pemal Pab-Tummad-nuskan-pilaled-choggu, al pemal Pabyobzhal kued-wilubmo.
Imi Cristo anmal-pilalgus, tegin anmal-anal Pabga aga chan ukcha, tule-Pabga-immal-kugedgin Pab-yer-wawadik-immal-itogedyob. Al pemal ampa Cristo-yopí pilaledgin naneenabmalmo.

Imi pemal Pab-Jesúsbak-akenanimaladbal, pemal-abalgin machergan omeganbak tegin punamalbak melle pel-iché omomalo yosgu nanegal. Tegin omegandemo macherganbak tegin machimalbak melle pel-iché omomalmogo yosgu nanegal. Tegin pemal melle pel-iché istar nanao; tegin pe melle pel-iché aku-aku immal peigunonimalbalo.

Tegin pe melle nial-nial chunmako, tegin pe melle kaka-ibga-keg-pel-kuedgin chunmako, tegin pe melle todoed-kaka-iskanagin chunmabalo. Tenal we igal ib-nued-chul. Tenal pemal Pabga pul tog-nuedi chogmalo.

Imi an pemalga napírra chogdo: imi tule ome-egadzhulidbak yosgu naneel, we tulega igal-kwen-maichul Pab-Tummad-tegin-Cristo-neg-takmaidgin toggal. Tegin omedemo machered-egadzhulidbak kudimogal, Pab-neg-takmaidgin kwen togojul-kumogo. Tegin tule igal-istar-naneedgin yolejal, Pab-neg-takmaidgin kwen togojul-kumogo. Tegin tule aku-aku-immal-peiedgin naneel, we tulega igal-kwen-maichul, Pab-Tummad-tegin-Cristo-neg-takmaidgin toggalmo. Tenal we tulemal Pab-Tummadyob-chowal-mimmiganzhe-kolmalad-tulemal.

Imi an pemalga we igal-iskanagin chunmajadgin, tule pemalga chunmanonikil: “Wedin iwen-akalzhul weob nanegal,” tenal pe melle we tulebal ibzhemalo, tegin pe melle we tulebal yardalenonimalbalo. Imi tule Pab-chogzhad-itojulidbal tegin tule igal-iskanagin-kudiidbal, Pab Tummad urwedgin sapejul tar-oturdanoniko.
Al pemal melle we tulemalbak mecha nanemalo.

Tenal pemal akpene immal kwen wichulmalan Pab-igalgin nanegal, tule-neg-chichidgin aku ata-kudiidyob. Tenal imidin pemal Pab-Jesúsbak mecha kudimal-choggu, al pemal wisgunonimal igi Pab-igalgin nanegal, tule-neg-taledgin mag atagedyob. Al pemal tule-Pab-Jesús-wismaladyob pe naneed-wilubmal.
Imi pemal pirkin-immal-wijiidbal, pel-kwapa igal-nuegan tegin igal-innikigwad, tegin igal-chunchunnad, pebal mag taklenoniko.
Tegin pemal turdakenabmalbal, piti-igal Pab-Jesús pul yer tak.
Tenal pemal melle igal-iskanaje omoedgin pinzhao. Tenal igal-iskana ibga keg pel ku. Tenal pemal tulemalga nuekwa chogenabmal, we igal ibiga istar.
Imi pe melle tule-otukal-nisaal-immal-imakedgin chunmamalo. Wedin pinche tule-opinkezheed.
Tenal pemal tule-uanaieneele, pe chogenab, we igal, igal-nuedzhul, wedin igal-iskana. Tenal pe weob tulega chogzhal, pedin we tulega oyonai, neg-taledgin immal-nued takchiidyob.
Tenal tule neg-taledgin kep nuekwa immal taknonidaedyob kunonikojun. Al akpene choglesgusdo:

content.text: Imi pe takmaldo, we igal ib-nuedzhul,

content: Tegin pemal melle tule-immal-kwen-wichulidyob nanemalo, tenal pemal nue aga takermal pinzheed-nikadgin nanegal.
Tenal pemalga ibe-iskana naidbal, pe melle ibe perienzhao, pe nuekwa ibe ebugenabmal Pab-peiedyob nanegal.
Tegin pemal melle pinzheed-nikchulidyob nanemalo, tenal pemal nuekwa itogo, Pabdin igi pei ega nanegal.
Tegin pemal melle mumurgumalo. Imi pe mumurgumalal, pe kalagwenzhul nanadamalo. Tenal pedin pela-pela Pab-Purpa-Nued-nikadgin kudiguenab.

Tenal pemal aga emal-emal salmo-namakedgin, tegin Pab-otummoed-namakedgin tegin purpal-tule-okannoed-namakedgin pe namadimalo. Imi pemal aga ulubgin weligwal-itogedgin Pabzhe namamalo Pab-otummomalgal.
Tenal pemal keg-chulgu anmal-Tummad-Jesucristo-nuggin pel-kwapa Pab Tummadga tog-nuedi chogo.
Machered aga e-ome-pilalguenab, omedemo aga e-machered-ulpallí naneed-wilubmo
Imi pemal Cristogin-atagedbal, aga emal-emal ulpallí aga naneenabmal.
Omegan-machergan-nikmalad, imi pemal Pab-Jesús-pilaledbal, aga pe-machered-ulpallí naneed-wilubmal.
¿Ibiga an teob chog? Imi Cristo tule-ebal-nanimalad-e-nono, tenal anmaldin Cristo-e-chanyob. Tegin Cristo anmal-abonogedga maibal. Al tule-machered aga e-ome-e-nonomo.
Imi tule-Pabbal-nanimalad Cristo-ulpallí naneedyob, omegan aga e-machered-ulpallí meke-ibigin naneed-wilubmalmo.
Machergan-omegan-nikmalad, imi pemal aga pe-ome-pilalguenabmal, Cristo tule-ebal-nanimalad-pilalgudiidyobmo. Imi Cristo tule-ebal-nanimalad-pilaledbal aga chan ukcha, tegin Cristo
tule-ebal-nanimaladga aga kakal-chogzhadbal iskued eligal, tegin tigin-oglejadgin chwilidik tule-ebal-nanimalad-imagalbal.

Imi an-chogzhadyob Cristo immal imas, mag taklenonigal, tule-ebal-nanimalad ome-nugu-taklegedyob pel kutu-kutujul, tegin wagal pel papi-papijulbal, pel-kwapa yer-takle. Imi an-chogzhad-yopí Cristo chwilidik tegin immal-akaloed-kwen-nikchul tule-ebal-nanimalad-imasbal.
Imi pemal-machergan, pe aga tukin pe-chan pilaledyob, aga pe-ome-pilalguenabmalmo. Imi tule aga ome-pilaledgin naneel, we tule aga tukin chan pilalgunaimo.
Imi tule aga tukin istar e-chan kwen taktijul. Tenal tule pul-pule masgin aga chan okunta, tegin tule aga nuekwa chan akwebal.
Tenal anmal-Cristo-e-chanmogad-ulgin, al Cristo ampa tule-ebal-nanimalad nued akwemo.
Imi ome aga e-machered-chanyob-choggu, al machimal aga-pab-aga-nan-ebeenabmal, aga e-omebak mecha-nanegal. Tegin we abirgin aga chan-walkwénnagwadga kunonimalo.
Imi we abirgin chan-walkwénna-kunonikid anmal mag kwen itojulmal. Tenal antin Cristogin tegin tule-ebal-nanimaladgin purpal chunmajii.
Tenal pemal-ilbal, aga pe pilaledyob, aga pe-ome-pilalgumogo. Tegin omegandin aga e-macheredgin atakallé naneenabmalmo.
